_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve phase_field#5: without a tension/compression split a compressive load nucleates exactly as much damage as tension, and the psi_plus shipped in phase_field_fracture_2d (a vol-dev split) does NOT reach the quoted max(d) < 1e-3. Verified on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh=0.15 (ne=96, VectorH1 order 1 ndof=126 with 94 free, H1 ndof=63), confined uniaxial loading dirichletx='left|right' dirichlety='bottom|top', |u_y|=0.03, E=1 nu=0.3 Gc=1e-3 l0=0.1 (2026-08-06): no split gives max(d)=1.080617e-01 in BOTH tension and compression, the shipped vol-dev split gives 1.304348e-01 / 4.411765e-02, and a spectral (principal-strain) split gives 1.080617e-01 / 3.909618e-32. Also pins that with the shipped elastic step (which wipes the Dirichlet entries) every energy reports max(d)=0 under compression, so the sanity test passes while measuring nothing.
